verdict.rationale: The evidence names one first-party public API, the My Organization API, for building in-app administrative experiences, so Auth0 directly exposes some programmatic control. The pack never documents a general tenant-management API, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. The MCP server, CLI and Terraform module are separate interfaces and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented general-purpose management/REST API covering apps, users and configuration, API reference depth, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Deliver custom in-app administrative experiences with My Organization API, or embed our pre-built, white-labeled components.
